title: 💾 Storage Memory Prices Are Finally Falling!
body: 💾 Storage Memory Prices Are Finally Falling!
Prices of NAND flash — the memory inside phones, computers, and storage drives — have fallen by about 20% since mid-October.
Bank of America expects a further drop of 5–10% in first-quarter 2027 contracts, which could mean cheaper storage drives.
But be careful: the drop so far is in the wholesale market for components, and the prices of ready-made drives in stores have not fallen yet — so don’t expect the discount tomorrow.
Are you waiting for prices to drop before buying a new drive? Or will you buy now?
